title.narrative: Leveraging Sites of Memory of the Slave Trade to Combat Racism and Promote Intercultural Inclusion in Cuba, the Dominican Republic, and Venezuela.

description.narrative: Cuba, the Dominican Republic, and Venezuela hold significant sites of memory linked to the history of enslavement and the slave trade. This initiative strengthens national capacities to combat racism and discrimination by positioning these memory sites as contemporary resources for intercultural dialogue and inclusive social narratives. Activities include a regional webinar, a hybrid event to support the inscription of sites in the Network of Places of History and Memory related to the Slave Trade, and support to the National Committees of UNESCO’s programme Routes of Enslaved Peoples: Resistance, Liberty, Heritage to enhance their role in promoting anti-discrimination and social inclusion.
